_readme: Prompt manifest for the element library's demo media. Regenerate with the lab's packages/site_package/Build/Scripts/generate-library-images.mjs, which shells out to `typo3 sitepackage:llm:generate-image` so the OpenAI key stays in the nr-vault and never touches this repo. Output filenames are lib-<role>-<slug>-<content hash>.webp; the hash matters because ExtensionFalSeeder imports by basename into one flat fileadmin folder and never re-imports a name it has already seen. Roles map to LibraryImageAssetProvider::ROLE_RULES.

styles.editorial: Editorial photograph. Natural window light, shallow depth of field, calm contemporary palette of warm neutrals with one muted teal accent. Realistic, unstaged, modern workplace. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no readable screen content, no visible brand marks.
styles.hero: Wide editorial photograph with deliberate negative space on one side for a headline. Natural light, shallow depth of field, calm contemporary palette of warm neutrals with one muted teal accent. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
styles.portrait: Professional headshot, waist-up, subject looking at the camera with a relaxed natural expression. Soft even studio light, plain light-grey seamless backdrop, shallow depth of field. Contemporary business-casual clothing in muted solid colours. Photorealistic, neutral colour grade, no props, no text, no logos.
styles.logo: Flat vector-style company logo lockup on a plain white background: a simple geometric mark next to the company name in a clean modern geometric sans-serif. Two colours at most. Centred, generous margin, crisp edges, no gradients, no photographic texture, no drop shadow, no tagline, no extra words.
styles.badge: Flat vector-style circular certification seal on a plain white background. Two-tone slate and muted teal, concentric ring, simple central glyph, subtle laurel or shield silhouette. Centred, crisp edges, no gradients, no photographic texture, no lettering.
styles.illustration: Flat editorial vector illustration on a plain off-white background. Limited palette of slate, sand and muted teal, simple geometric shapes, generous negative space, no outlines heavier than the shapes themselves. Modern, calm, no text, no logos, no faces.
